scenario: 今天基础设施赛道的主线，是在训练和推理里把算力和显存用得更省。强化学习后训练这边，FlexFloor 让生成完的 GPU 提前释放，EE-RL 按阶段给 GPU 降频省电，MoEResQ 说明 FP4 训练的修正要在训练和生成两侧对称。推理这边，SPARE 压缩线性注意力的循环状态，一项研究说明 KV cache 复用的修复预算该花在答案片段上，SafeStart 提醒减少 MoE 专家提速的同时要检查模型的拒绝率。向量索引建库、AMD 上的 FP8 注意力内核、按硬件剪枝和 FLUX 3 的 Blackwell 优化，则是各自环节的提速。

papers.title: Turbocharging PiPNN for Proximity and k-NN Graph Building
papers.authors: Tobias Rubel, Richard Wen, Guy Blelloch, Laxman Dhulipala, Lars Gottesbüren, Jakub Łącki, Vahab Mirrokni
papers.abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) indexes such as HNSW and Vamana deliver state-of-the-art query performance at the cost of large indexing times. The recently introduced PiPNN method drastically accelerated index construction by way of a partitioning-based algorithm leveraging dense matrix multiplication and top-$K$ aggregation kernels. In this paper, we unlock the full potential of PiPNN's hardware-friendly algorithm design. We introduce PiPNN II, which optimizes multiple steps of the PiPNN recipe, giving up to $8\times$ speedups for graph-based ANNS index construction. In addition, we present GPiPNN, a GPU implementation which builds comparable ANNS indices up to $43.7\times$ faster than Jasper and up to $50\times$ faster than CAGRA. We also extend PiPNN II and GPiPNN to compute high-quality $k$-NN graphs directly, which unlocks massive speedups over methods used in many existing systems for clustering, anomaly detection, and more. For 10-NN graph building at $90\%$ recall, we obtain up to a $13\times$ speedup on CPUs and $6.6\times$ on GPUs as compared to the prior best methods. PiPNN II can build a billion-scale 10-NN graph in under 16 minutes. Common to both PiPNN II and GPiPNN is the use of quantization to reduce memory traffic and leverage fast low-precision matrix operations. Top-$K$ emerges as a new bottleneck, which we optimize with specialized code for specific $K$, and by fusing with the matrix kernel to avoid materializing the distance matrix to memory. On CPUs, we demonstrate further performance improvements by leveraging our matrix kernels in the RobustPrune procedure proposed in Vamana and used in PiPNN. On GPUs, we flatten recursive partitioning into segmented batches, use one fused top-$K$ abstraction for partitioning and leaf scoring, and prune with already-witnessed direct edges rather than new candidate-to-candidate scoring passes.
papers.summary: 向量检索常用的图索引（HNSW、Vamana 这类）查询快，但建起来很慢，大数据集要几小时甚至几天。PiPNN 的思路是先把向量分成小块，块内用矩阵乘法找近邻，再合成一张图，比逐点插入快得多。这篇论文继续压榨这条路线：把向量量化成低精度，减少内存搬运；再把矩阵乘法和取前 K 个近邻合成一次计算，不再把整张距离矩阵写回内存。结果是 CPU 版建索引比原版 PiPNN 最高快 8 倍，GPU 版比 CAGRA 最高快 50 倍，高召回下的查询性能不输对手。需要经常重建向量索引的团队，建库时间有望不再是瓶颈。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Rahul Sharma, Nitin Vegesna, Yanxin Zhang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for language models alternates between generating responses and training the policy. These stages place different demands on GPUs, creating opportunities to reduce clock frequency with little loss in throughput. Selecting frequencies online is difficult because response lengths change and frequency trials themselves consume time and energy. We present EE-RL (energy-efficient RL), an online controller that selects separate frequencies for generation and training during RL execution. It compares candidate settings with a prediction of the default GPU governor on the same token workload, and keeps the most energy-efficient setting that meets a throughput threshold. The controller then monitors throughput and energy and adjusts frequencies as the workload changes. Fixed-frequency sweeps on H100 and GB200 show GPU energy savings of up to 28.2% per valid training token across synchronous and asynchronous execution, while largely preserving throughput. EE-RL turns this headroom into online savings, reducing GPU energy per valid training token by up to 16.9% at a modest throughput cost.
papers.summary: 强化学习后训练很耗电，但 GPU 不必一直满频跑：生成回答时一次只出一个 token，常卡在显存带宽上，等其他卡的时间也在耗电，降频几乎不拖慢速度。NVIDIA 的这项工作做了一个在线控制器 EE-RL，给生成和训练分别选 GPU 频率。它先按同样的 token 工作量预测默认调度的表现作参照，再用几轮短试验挑选，只要吞吐不低于默认的 98%，就留下最省电的设置，之后随负载变化调整。在训练和生成分开部署的同步设置下，最多省 16.9% 的 GPU 能耗，吞吐只低 1.4%。不改算法，也能降电费。

papers.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
papers.authors: Jia Wei, Ziyi Qiu, Yi Xu, Xuehai Qian
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
papers.summary: MoE 模型做强化学习后训练时，生成回答这一步常被最长的几条回答拖住：自己的回答已经写完的 GPU 也不能撤，因为专家分散在各张卡上，没写完的回答随时要用到这些卡上的专家。论文测到，基线里约三分之一的占用时间发生在本卡回答结束之后。FlexFloor 先用历史回答长度预测每条回答要写多久，把预计长度相近的提示词安排在一起，让它们差不多同时写完；写完的卡就从专家并行的小组里撤出，专家在留下的卡之间重新摆放，让它们合起来仍装得下全部专家，并留足 KV cache 空间。生成吞吐提高 52.74%，每单位占用的计算时间多生成约 65.40% 的 token，rollout 奖励基本不变。

papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.authors: Sheldon Liang, Ali Taghibakhshi, Saurav Muralidharan, Sharath Turuvekere Sreenivas, Ashwath Aithal, Pavlo Molchanov, Nima Tajbakhsh
papers.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.
papers.summary: 给大模型剪枝，常见做法是先定一个参数量目标，但参数量并不决定延迟、吞吐和显存。论文里两个参数量相同的模型，窄而深的那个在 RTX 5070 上延迟高 35%。AutoCompress 反过来，把部署硬件的限制直接放进结构搜索：用和推理引擎实测对得上的成本模型，同时调整整体结构和每一层的大小，得到各层宽度不一样的模型。在本地长上下文编码、数据中心批量服务、游戏内低延迟交互三类场景下，它在八个基准上的平均准确率，比 Minitron 剪枝在 RTX 5070 上高 6.57 个百分点，在 H100 上只高 0.57 个。给具体显卡剪模型时，按目标硬件搜结构，在小显卡上收益最大。

papers.title: SafeStart: Mitigating the Overlooked Safety Cost of Active Expert Reduction in MoE LLM Serving
papers.authors: Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Saeid Shokoufa, Seyedarmin Azizi, Arya Fayyazi, Souvik Kundu, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models send each token through a few of many expert subnetworks. Serving methods make these models faster by running even fewer experts per token, and they are validated on accuracy benchmarks. We show that these methods can weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and we introduce SafeStart, which largely restores refusal while keeping most of the speedup. In vLLM on one RTX A6000, keeping about two thirds of the selected experts speeds up offline decoding by 15 to 28% at batch size 8. We find that, at this setting, under a jailbreak that tells the model not to refuse, the share of harmful requests that the model answers rises by 18.4 percentage points on Qwen1.5-MoE, 9.5 on OLMoE, and 6.6 on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the three of nine models where it rises significantly, while MMLU accuracy drops by less than two points. We discover that most of this increase arises while the model processes the prompt and generates its first few tokens. SafeStart therefore runs all experts for the prompt and the first eight generated tokens, and the reduced set of experts afterwards, through a fused kernel in vLLM. With experts removed, SafeStart keeps at least 85% of the offline decode speedup at batch sizes 8 and 32 and brings the change under this jailbreak to between -2.1 and +1.3 points for three expert-reduction methods on these three models. On 889 held-out requests, in an analysis fixed before generation, truncation raises harmful compliance by 5.8 to 21.4 points, and SafeStart leaves a rise of 0.6 to 2.6 points, non-inferior to the original model on two of the three models. Our results show that faster MoE serving need not cost safety: a serving system can keep most of the gain from running fewer experts by running all of them at the start of each response, and it should test refusal, not only accuracy, before it enables such a method.
papers.summary: MoE 模型为了推理更快，常让每个 token 只跑一部分专家，上线前一般只看准确率。这篇论文发现，这样做会削弱模型对有害请求的拒绝：在一个告诉模型不要拒绝的越狱提示下，保留约三分之二专家时，Qwen1.5-MoE 回答有害请求的比例上升 18.4 个百分点，而 MMLU 准确率几乎不变。增幅大多出现在模型读提示词和生成最开头几个 token 的时候。SafeStart 因此在提示词和最开头几个 token 上跑全部专家，之后才换成精简的专家集合，离线解码仍保住至少 85% 的提速，越狱下的变化也压回接近零。上线专家裁剪之前，要测拒绝率，不能只测准确率。

papers.title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.authors: Hei Yi Mak, Hoang Le, Mehran Taghian Jazi, Yunke Peng, Huan Lin, Zhengzhi Tang, Zhexu Liu, Yao Wang, Yaoyuan Wang, Anandharaju Durai Raju, Tanzila Rahman
papers.abstract: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities, and router selection matching rates. Building on this finding, we propose MoEResQ, a quantization-recovery recipe for MoE RL post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. MoEResQ restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision, establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in FP4 RL for MoE models.
papers.summary: FP4 精度做强化学习后训练能省显存和算力，但精度掉得多。稠密模型上已有一种补救办法 RolloutResQ：激活量化成 FP4 会丢掉一部分精度，丢掉的部分叫残差，它把残差再单独量化一份，两份结果相加补回精度，但只在生成回答那一侧做。这篇论文发现它搬到 MoE 模型上不但没用，在四个数学基准里有三个比不做任何补救还差。原因在路由：专家是离散选出来的，只有生成一侧做了修正，同一个 token 在训练和生成两侧可能被送去不同专家，两边的策略就对不上。MoEResQ 让训练侧也做同样的修正。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，AIME24 与 BF16 的准确率差距，从不补救的 24.27 个点缩小到 3.75 个点。

papers.title: Where Should a KV-Cache Repair Budget Go? Distractor Structure and Contextual Compatibility in Non-Prefix Reuse
papers.authors: Yuxing Peng, Zhiqing Tang, Weijia Jia
papers.abstract: Non-prefix KV-cache reuse encodes retrieved chunks independently and concatenates their caches. To find where a small repair budget should be spent, we vary the chunks around the answer-bearing one (the target) across three 7B-8B models and four datasets of dialogue memory, open-domain QA and API documentation. Reuse loses 19-100% of the context-dependent questions that full prefill answers, and it loses more when the other chunks are of the same kind as the target. Because the recoverable damage is spread over these other chunks, restoring a few of them recovers little, and the budget is better spent on the target. This works through contextual compatibility: recomputing the target against the reused cache beats inserting its full-prefill KV in all seven settings tested, although the recomputed KV stays far from the full-prefill KV. Question attention over reused caches, however, selects the target in at most 18.8% of development questions. A retriever finds it more often, and recomputing its top chunk after moving it next to the question significantly beats InfoFlow-style reordering at the same 5% budget in six of nine open-domain QA and API-documentation settings. On dialogue memory, though, recomputing chunks never significantly beats the token-level selector chosen for each setting.
papers.summary: RAG 和对话记忆为了省 prefill，会把每个检索片段单独编码，再把各自的 KV cache 拼起来用。代价是每个片段看不到前面的片段，答案容易出错：论文在三个模型、四个数据集上测，原本完整 prefill 答得对的、依赖上下文的问题，复用后丢掉 19% 到 100%，周围有和答案片段相似的内容时丢得更多。修复预算很小时，去修这些干扰片段几乎没用，更值得把预算花在答案所在的片段上，让它对着已复用的缓存重算。实际中不知道哪段是答案，用问题的注意力去找最多只找对 18.8%，用检索器的第一名片段更可靠。

papers.title: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4
papers.authors: Quentin Anthony, Ganesh Bikshandi, Praneeth Medepalli, Stephen Ebert
papers.abstract: Attention is a core building block of frontier models and often dominates compute-bound prefill at long context. FP8 matrix instructions offer twice the peak throughput of BF16, but they accelerate only matrix multiplication, and the softmax between the two matrix multiplications of attention runs on vector units that FP8 does not accelerate. On the AMD Instinct MI355X, the vendor's AITER kernels reach 39% of peak FP8 matrix throughput at 32K tokens, compared with 49% in BF16. Attention is also more numerically sensitive to quantization than feed-forward layers, and unlike NVIDIA's Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, the MI355X does not track the completion of matrix instructions in hardware, so overlapping the softmax with the matrix multiplications depends on instruction order. We present ZYFA, prefill kernels for the MI355X built on three techniques: (1) computing each FP8 probability directly from its score with a multiply-add and an integer conversion instead of an exponential; (2) a ping-pong schedule in which one group of threads computes its softmax while another executes its matrix multiplications; and (3) scaling each block of probabilities up by a power of two before rounding, and normalizing by the sum of the rounded probabilities. On attention inputs captured from three models and timed at sustained clock speeds, ZYFA achieves 1.16-1.76x the throughput of AITER. On the Gaussian inputs of kernel benchmarks at 32K tokens, it achieves 1.26-1.37x at head dimension 128 and 1.99x for DeepSeek-style multi-head latent attention. The sustained clock of the MI355X depends on operand values, so throughput on random inputs does not reliably predict throughput on real model activations. At head dimension 128, ZYFA's numerical error is within a few percent of that of Composable Kernel and Triton and 62-78% lower than that of AITER's. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zyphra/zyfa.
papers.summary: FP8 的矩阵乘法吞吐是 BF16 的两倍，但注意力里两次矩阵乘法之间的 softmax 在向量单元上跑，FP8 帮不上忙，整体加速因此打折。在 AMD MI355X 上，官方的 AITER 内核处理长上下文时只跑到 FP8 矩阵峰值的 39%。ZYFA 重写了 prefill 内核。FP8 的位模式近似于数值以 2 为底的对数，所以把注意力分数乘一个系数、加一个偏移再取整，得到的整数直接当作 FP8 的位模式，就是近似的概率，不用再算指数。它还让一组线程算 softmax 的同时，另一组线程做矩阵乘法。在三个模型的真实输入上，吞吐是 AITER 的 1.16 到 1.76 倍，数值误差也更小。

papers.title: SPARE: Fast Linear Attention Decoding with Compact Recurrent States
papers.authors: Ke Wan, Zaiyi Zheng, Chen Chen
papers.abstract: Linear attention reduces the quadratic sequence-length complexity of softmax attention by maintaining fixed-size recurrent states. However, these states scale quadratically with the representation dimension and require repeated data transfers during decoding, creating a substantial GPU memory bottleneck. Recent studies have revealed significant low-rank redundancy in recurrent states, suggesting opportunities for more efficient representations. We introduce SPARE (State Projection for Accelerated Recurrent Execution), a training-free method that exploits this redundancy through fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous rank allocation, and lightweight write compensation. By performing recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states, SPARE reduces memory traffic without online decomposition or dense-state reconstruction. SPARE achieves 2.55x full-model decoding speedup, 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel DRAM traffic, and 3.31x lower peak GPU memory, while preserving better associative-retrieval accuracy than structured pruning at matched memory budgets.
papers.summary: 线性注意力解码时不需要随长度增长的 KV cache，但每步都要读写一个固定大小的循环状态矩阵，搬运大量数据，高并发下成了显存带宽瓶颈。SPARE 利用的观察是：这些状态矩阵的有效秩往往远小于原始维度，各个注意力头还差别很大。它不用重新训练，先在少量校准数据上对每个头的 K 向量做主成分分析，取前几个方向作为固定的低维基，总维度预算则逐个分配，每次把下一个维度给状态矩阵里剩余奇异值贡献最大的头。之后直接在压缩后的状态上读写。K 向量投到低维后，向量长度的平方会变小，每次写入的强度随之变弱，所以写入时除以这个平方来补回（设有上限）。整个模型解码快 2.55 倍，峰值显存降到原来的三分之一左右（3.31 倍）。

papers.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
papers.authors: Olivia Stoner, Yiheng Zhang, Chang Liu, Seonghee Lee, Gunjan Mehta
papers.abstract:
This tutorial shows how to configure FLUX 3 Image Klein in NVIDIA TensorRT LLM VisualGen to take advantage of fused kernels, multi-GPU parallelism, FP8/NVFP4 support, caching, and attention optimizations. It compares latency and changes in generated outputs across optimizations.
In the reported 2048×2048 tests on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU, combined optimizations delivered up to 3.46x faster text-to-image (T2I) and 4.45x faster image-to-image (I2I) generation for FLUX 3 Image Klein Base compared with uncompiled BF16 inference. The tutorial includes deployment instructions and YAML configurations for applying these optimizations to your workloads.
papers.summary: 在设计工具和图片编辑里部署扩散模型，延迟很敏感：一张图要经过模型多次串行计算，分辨率越高，注意力 越贵。NVIDIA 的技术博客以 FLUX 3 Image Klein 为例，演示在 TensorRT LLM VisualGen 里可以叠加的几类优化。单张 B200 上，只把 BF16 换成 NVFP4，文生图就快 1.62 倍；再叠加融合内核、缓存等优化，高分辨率下文生图最高快 3.46 倍，两者都是对比未编译的 BF16。博客还逐项给出了每种优化带来的图像差异，并附有可直接使用的 YAML 配置。
